## Haul Fleet Failure Risk & Early Warning Analysis

**Eight ultra-class haul trucks show HIGH risk (score 100) driven by elevated tyre temperature today (22 Oct 2026), and historically IoT signals flag problems an average of 7.3 days before SAP maintenance notifications are raised** – giving the operation a critical window to intervene before unplanned downtime.

**Provenance:** Fleet telemetry · Historian, TPMS (OPS).

### Early-Warning Value

Across 74 historical failures, IoT risk signals appeared **7.3 days (avg.) before SAP maintenance notifications**, with a 4–12 day range (MIXED: risk from fleet telemetry, notification timestamps from SAP BDC MaintenanceNotification). Critical parts and spares are currently OK (SAP_STANDIN), but the sole supplier (USSU-VSF84) has only 73.8% on-time delivery (SAP_STANDIN).

**Why it matters:** Tyre over-temperature cascades to rim damage, unplanned stoppages, and lost haulage capacity—each 220-tonne truck offline reduces throughput and raises cost per tonne.

**Recommended action:** Schedule HT-06 (highest 3-day stress trend +0.211, last breakdown only 16 days ago) for immediate tyre and TPMS inspection during the next shift change to prevent an imminent failure.
